notes.title: ☪️ TSUNDERE MILFIN — Update 1.15 is live!
notes.notes:
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2307220/extras/450hader.gif
🆕 Update 1.15 is now available in-game!

A fresh update has just been released for our beloved office sim — check it out now! 

Version 1.15 adds a brand new situation on the map that brings even more intrigue to your workdays. You’ll also find 2 fully animated scenes and 1 minigame waiting for you. 🔥 ːfuhrer_heartː

To access the new content, you’ll need the Strange Coin. 🪙
What happens if you use it? Who knows… but HR is already watching. 😳

Just one rule:
NO RUNNING ON THE STAIRS!
(Seriously. We’re running out of warning signs.) 💦
